title: Tiny, cute skateboard
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='deck' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b9d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e0356e'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='grip' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5a2a6e'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3d1a4d'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id='wheel' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe680'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffc233'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Deck top (grip tape) -->
  <path d='M14,52 Q14,42 24,42 L76,42 Q86,42 86,52 L86,56 Q86,58 84,58 L16,58 Q14,58 14,56 Z' fill='url(#grip)'/>
  <!-- Deck side (wood/color) -->
  <path d='M14,52 Q14,42 24,42 L76,42 Q86,42 86,52 L86,58 Q86,62 82,62 L18,62 Q14,62 14,58 Z' fill='url(#deck)'/>
  <!-- Deck highlight edge -->
  <path d='M20,44 L80,44' stroke='#ffb3cc' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Kicktail curve left -->
  <path d='M14,52 Q10,48 12,44 Q13,42 18,42' stroke='#ff8fb3' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Kicktail curve right -->
  <path d='M86,52 Q90,48 88,44 Q87,42 82,42' stroke='#ff8fb3' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Truck front -->
  <rect x='28' y='60' width='14' height='6' rx='3' fill='#b8c4d0'/>
  <rect x='30' y='66' width='10' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8899aa'/>
  <!-- Truck back -->
  <rect x='58' y='60' width='14' height='6' rx='3' fill='#b8c4d0'/>
  <rect x='60' y='66' width='10' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8899aa'/>
  <!-- Wheel front left -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='74' r='8' fill='url(#wheel)'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='74' r='4' fill='#e09a20'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='72' r='1.5' fill='#fff3cc'/>
  <!-- Wheel front right -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='74' r='8' fill='url(#wheel)'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='74' r='4' fill='#e09a20'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='72' r='1.5' fill='#fff3cc'/>
  <!-- Wheel back left -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='74' r='8' fill='url(#wheel)'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='74' r='4' fill='#e09a20'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='72' r='1.5' fill='#fff3cc'/>
  <!-- Wheel back right -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='74' r='8' fill='url(#wheel)'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='74' r='4' fill='#e09a20'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='72' r='1.5' fill='#fff3cc'/>
  <!-- Cute smiley face on deck -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='50' r='1.8' fill='#ffd1e0'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='50' r='1.8' fill='#ffd1e0'/>
  <path d='M46,53 Q50,56 54,53' stroke='#ffd1e0' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Little stars sparkle -->
  <path d='M88,34 L89,30 L90,34 L94,35 L90,36 L89,40 L88,36 L84,35 Z' fill='#fff9c4'/>
  <path d='M10,32 L11,29 L12,32 L15,33 L12,34 L11,37 L10,34 L7,33 Z' fill='#ffe082'/>
</svg>
